title: Account operations.
caption: The first column is the descriptive name we propose; the second is the symbol exported at the pin and by the testnet preview, which this paper's prose uses. Exporting the first column's names is proposed, not done. *Owner authorization* means an account-document rule that targets the account and whose function policy allows the entry point; a rule with no function list, like the constructor's, allows all of them. [`docs/account-interface.md`](https://github.com/bitswell-hq/stellar-registry__perch/blob/f0275f41c5ab47c903bbfe9986b4bf3239c01b11/docs/account-interface.md) lists the account's other entry points.
